name: lib_fib_mul_modEq_sq_of_dvd
statement: (m N : ℕ) (u v : ℤ) (h0 : (Nat.fib N : ℤ) = (m : ℤ) * u) (h1 : (Nat.fib (N + 1) : ℤ) = 1 + (m : ℤ) * v) (j : ℕ) : (Nat.fib (j * N) : ℤ) ≡ (j : ℤ) * (m : ℤ) * u [ZMOD ((m ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)] ∧ (Nat.fib (j * N + 1) : ℤ) ≡ 1 + (j : ℤ) * (m : ℤ) * v [ZMOD ((m ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)]
closed: ∀ (m N : ℕ) (u v : ℤ) (h0 : (Nat.fib N : ℤ) = (m : ℤ) * u) (h1 : (Nat.fib (N + 1) : ℤ) = 1 + (m : ℤ) * v) (j : ℕ), (Nat.fib (j * N) : ℤ) ≡ (j : ℤ) * (m : ℤ) * u [ZMOD ((m ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)] ∧ (Nat.fib (j * N + 1) : ℤ) ≡ 1 + (j : ℤ) * (m : ℤ) * v [ZMOD ((m ^ 2 : ℕ) : ℤ)]
informal: promoted from Mathlib2.bld5_pisano_mul_dvd_mul_aux2 (the square-zero lifting lemma specialised to ZMod (m^2), stated as congruences): if F_N = m·u and F_{N+1} = 1 + m·v then modulo m^2, F_{jN} ≡ j·m·u and F_{jN+1} ≡ 1 + j·m·v. For the general ring form (μ^2 = 0) use the aux lemma directly.
type: ∀ (m N : ℕ) (u v : ℤ), ↑(Nat.fib N) = ↑m * u → ↑(Nat.fib (N + 1)) = 1 + ↑m * v → ∀ (j : ℕ), ↑(Nat.fib (j * N)) ≡ ↑j * ↑m * u [ZMOD ↑(m ^ 2)] ∧ ↑(Nat.fib (j * N + 1)) ≡ 1 + ↑j * ↑m * v [ZMOD ↑(m ^ 2)]
